description: This file defines the AppIntegrationsServiceClient class, which serves as a client interface for interacting with the Amazon AppIntegrations Service via AWS SDK for PHP. It specifies methods for creating, deleting, retrieving, listing, tagging, and updating various resources related to the service, and extends the AwsClient class.

classes.name: AppIntegrationsServiceClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the Amazon AppIntegrations Service, providing methods for resource management and operations on the service.

methods.name: createApplication
methods.description: Creates a new application within the Amazon AppIntegrations Service.

methods.name: createApplicationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new application within the Amazon AppIntegrations Service.

methods.name: createDataIntegration
methods.description: Creates a new data integration resource.

methods.name: createDataIntegrationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new data integration resource.

methods.name: createDataIntegrationAssociation
methods.description: Creates an association for a data integration.

methods.name: createDataIntegrationAssociationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates an association for a data integration.

methods.name: createEventIntegrationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new event integration.

methods.name: deleteDataIntegrationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a data integration resource.

methods.name: getApplication
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific application.

methods.name: getApplicationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details of a specific application.

methods.name: getDataIntegration
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific data integration.

methods.name: getDataIntegrationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details of a specific data integration.

methods.name: tagResourceAsync
